findings.claim: CTBTO workshop material reports that H10S calibration response changes appeared after electronic noise began in one hydrophone channel, with cross-talk to the other two channels.

CTBT IMS hydrophone stations receive laboratory end-to-end calibration before deployment, and deployed underwater electronics can be checked with known calibration waveforms injected into the digitizer path.

BAS/PDC record GB/NERC/BAS/PDC/01236 is the canonical Ascension Island bathymetric compilation and states an approximately 50 m grid derived from multibeam swath data.
The PDC/01236 lineage names four RRS James Clark Ross source cruises: JR53-AMT11, JR287, JR15001 and JR16-NG.
The compilation was produced with MB-System 5.5.2336/mbgrid using a Gaussian weighted mean, with source cleaning performed using mbedit.
The public PDC/01236 product is distributed in NetCDF and Arc/Info/ArcView ASCII forms and is covered by the UK Open Government Licence.
H10N1 is inside the published PDC/01236 bounding box.
H10S2 is outside the published PDC/01236 bounding box.

P0_A_HA10_POSITIVE_CONTROL.objective: Known event -> authoritative UTC/location -> H10N1/H10S2 waveform -> response correction -> in-band arrival positive control.

P0_B_NATIVE_CRUISE_TRACK.objective: H10N1 -> source cruise -> navigation bytes/track chart -> closest approach -> UTC -> multibeam/TOPAS/raw data pointer.

P1_A_H10S_CALIBRATION_TIMELINE.objective: Recover dated H10S calibration/noise/cross-talk/repair epochs and separate clean from contaminated windows.

P1_B_BLIND_ATLANTIC_117_121.objective: Inventory public 2011-2015 Atlantic hydrophone corpora and metadata suitable for blind 117-121 Hz clustering before any Love/EDEM anchor reveal.

VERIFY_SYNTHESIZE.objective: Preserve disagreements, deduplicate sources, verify UTC/coordinates/hashes and produce a next-gate map.
